images.name: prop_raven
images.prompt:
Generate ONE 1024×1024 square image. The entire canvas background MUST be solid opaque bright chroma green RGB(0,255,0), hex #00ff00. Green must be visibly present across the whole background. This is a green-background painting, not a transparent cutout. Do not remove the green background.
Paint one common raven perched on a tiny square brown wooden post cap. Show ONLY a short 6–8 cm slice of wood under the feet, with a flat square top and very shallow sides, fully within the canvas; no long post extending downward. Feet grip the square cap edge. Raven and cap completely inside the canvas with generous green margins, raven about 70% of image height. Body turned three-quarters toward viewer lower-right, head looking left, beak slightly open. Glossy black feathers with dark blue-violet sheen and warm sunset rim on back and head from screen upper-left.
IMAGE 1 is reference for painting style and camera only. Match the elevated high three-quarter ARPG camera and the hand-drawn 2D painted level look: confident tapered dark contours of varying weight, clean painted colour planes, restrained texture and simple feather groupings, cool violet shadows. One frame of hand-drawn animation, readable silhouette. No landscape, no other objects, no text, no border, no shadow on the green. The final image must retain the opaque pure #00ff00 background.

references.role: Approved level look — style and camera reference

retries.reason: First output lacked the required green background and showed excessive post length.
retries.change: Emphasized retaining opaque green and showing only a shallow square post cap.

concerns: Tool returned 1254×1254 instead of requested 1024×1024; copied without modification.
Raven occupies more than the requested approximately 70% height; body direction and camera elevation are imperfect.
Background appears uniformly green; exact #00ff00 was not measured.
